description: This file defines the FlagConverter class, a Java class that extends DelimitedListConverter to handle conversion and validation of flag-like string values within an Android project. It manages a set of predefined flag values, supports additional custom conversions, and provides reference resolution and variant suggestions.

classes.name: FlagConverter
classes.description: A converter class for handling Android flag attributes, supporting multiple values separated by '|', with variant generation, reference resolution, and custom conversion capabilities.

methods.name: FlagConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the converter with optional additional converter and predefined flag values.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Returns possible string variants for the current context, utilizing additional converter if provided.

methods.name: convertString
methods.description: Converts a string value, using predefined values or additional converter if necessary.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a string value to its string representation.

methods.name: getReferenceVariants
methods.description: Provides reference variants based on predefined flag values.

methods.name: createPsiReference
methods.description: Creates a PsiReference object for the given element and range.

methods.name: getTextRange
methods.description: Calculates the text range within the XML tag for reference resolution.

methods.name: resolveReference
methods.description: Resolves a string value to its corresponding PsiElement reference.

methods.name: getUnresolvedMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message when a flag value cannot be resolved.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the set of predefined flag values.
